# Sama määrä kolmella tavalla — integration implementation boundary

2026-10-27. Authorized next node after quantity–numeral acceptance; no canonical admission or completion yet. Follow the supplied Finnish card and actual frozen node. M-NUM-03 is an integration KC requiring all_of M-NUM-QTY-WORD, M-NUM-QTY-NUMERAL and M-NUM-WORD-NUMERAL. Pair decisions or their three acquired states alone must not satisfy separate integration evidence.

The learner helps match an actual prepared group, decimal numeral and Finnish number word to the same supply box. Reuse existing representation validation and selection vocabulary. A smallest explicit three-representation task should keep one supplied anchor and require both remaining choices, one action at a time. The second choice must never be auto-filled or constrained to the first. Keep both responses even when inconsistent, and explain the actually wrong link. A word remains a genuine target representation; optional listening must be separate from committing a choice and may not supply an unrelated numeral/count answer.

Integration truth: all three selected representations encode the same cardinal value. Record which relation is wrong without promoting a partially correct composite answer into prerequisite mastery. Keep required child qualification through reconstructed current compatible immediate evidence and localized repair, matching the existing progression contract; do not claim three retained credentials or add a calendar wait. Preserve the independent integration role; do not relabel this as a finite-association process or extend exemplar-specific semantic-choice lookups.
